newsitem.title: USA: US Order unit launches Internet service.
newsitem.headline: US Order unit launches Internet service.

text.p: SmartTime Network, a new division of US Order Inc, said Monday it had launched an Internet service that can be used without a personal computer.
SmartTime said the service, called SmartTime Internet Services, will allow users to get information from the Internet through a pager, a telephone with a small screen or other communications device.
The service will also provide access to electronic mail and other Internet activities for $7.95 a month, it said.
SmartTime said it will not charge users for the amount of time that they are connected to the service or impose a fee for the use of any of its applications.
It said it will contract the manufacturers of the pagers and other devices to market the service. Colonial Data Technologies Corp will be the first reseller of the service, it added.
In early August, US Order Inc and Colombial Data Technologies agreed to merge in a stock swap that valued Colonial at about $150 million.
The merger, which created a new company called Tritech Corp, is aimed at giving service to the electronics commerce market.
